remainingCorrectionFinding.detail: canonical() calls json.dumps with default ensure_ascii=True. value_bound() budgets 2+6*len(value) for strings and uses the same six-byte rate for Paths. A string containing N non-BMP Unicode code points requires 2+12*N ASCII bytes because each is serialized as two six-byte surrogate escapes; the stated bound is only 2+6*N. Source-derived text is transported without an ASCII/BMP restriction. Therefore baseline=3*request_binary+4*request_metadata is not the promised conservative four-envelope-copy reservation for every admitted value. The worker understated-plan guard runs after parent Codec.encode/canonical have already allocated the encoded request. Existing preallocation regressions use ASCII and do not establish this missing bound.
